name: clock-example-schema
command: node --input-type=module -e "import {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\"; import assert from \"node:assert/strict\"; import {SessionStore} from \"./skills/tombo-view/scripts/session-store.mjs\"; import * as sdk from \"./dist/index.js\"; const c=JSON.parse(readFileSync(\"results/understanding-acceptance2/docs/post-G/clock-example/.session/task-clock.json\",\"utf8\")); assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(c).sort(),[\"basis\",\"deadlineAt\",\"sourceRef\",\"startedAt\"]); assert.equal(Date.parse(c.deadlineAt)-Date.parse(c.startedAt),600000); const store=new SessionStore(process.cwd(),sdk); const sealed=store.taskClock(c); assert.equal(sealed.basis,\"first_observed\"); assert.ok(Date.parse(sealed.recordedAt)>=Date.parse(c.startedAt)); console.log(JSON.stringify({descriptor:c,validatedBy:\"SessionStore.taskClock\",recordedAt:sealed.recordedAt,boundary:\"example syntax/schema/arithmetic only; no helper activation or semantic evaluation\"},null,2));"
